name: Create Custom Object
description: Create a custom object record in HubSpot. Set **Custom Object Type** to the object's `fullyQualifiedName` (e.g. `p_pets`; use **List Custom Object Schemas** to find it) and put fields in **Object Properties**. Example: Custom Object Type `p_pets`, Object Properties `{ "pet_name": "Rexy" }`. Returns the created record with its id. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/beta-docs/guides/api/crm/objects/custom-objects#create-a-custom-object)
